import hashlib, importlib.util, json, os, pathlib, sys
sys.dont_write_bytecode=True
r=pathlib.Path(pathlib.Path('/tmp/tsr-member-fields-path').read_text().strip())
repo=pathlib.Path('<repo>')
setup=json.loads((r/'setup.json').read_text()); prior=pathlib.Path(setup['prior_archive'])
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('perf',repo/'scripts/whole_project_perf.py'); perf=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(perf)
for key in list(os.environ):
    if key.startswith(('TSR_','TSGO_','RAYON_')): os.environ.pop(key)
ordinary={'main':setup['baseline_reuse']['binary'],'publication':json.loads((prior/'member-alias-build.json').read_text())['binary']}
observer={'main':json.loads((r/'legacy-corrected.json').read_text())['binary'],'publication':json.loads((r/'publication-observer.json').read_text())['binary']}
project=r/'source/benches/projects/domain-model-large/tsconfig.json'
paths=[str(p) for p in project.parent.rglob('*') if p.is_file()]+[str(p) for p in (r/'source/vendor/typescript-go/internal/bundled/libs').glob('*')]+[b['path'] for b in list(ordinary.values())+list(observer.values())]
reference=perf.inputs.snapshot(paths); assert perf.inputs.valid_snapshot(reference)
(r/'public-inputs.json').write_text(json.dumps(reference,indent=2)+'\n')
rows=[]
def counts(stderr):
    events=[]
    for line in stderr.splitlines():
        prefix,payload=line.split(' ',1)
        assert prefix in ['MEMBER_LEGACY','MEMBER_PUBLICATION']
        events.append({'kind':prefix,'counts':json.loads(payload)})
    return events
def listed(stdout):
    return [line for line in stdout.splitlines() if line.startswith(('/', 'bundled:///')) and line.endswith(('.ts','.tsx','.mts','.cts'))]
for mode in ['single','default']:
    for role in ['main','publication']:
        for phase in ['ordinary','off','count','time','count-repeat']:
            binary=ordinary[role] if phase=='ordinary' else observer[role]
            assert hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(binary['path']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==binary['sha256']
            before=perf.inputs.snapshot(paths); assert before==reference
            if phase in ['count','count-repeat']: os.environ['TSR_MEMBER_FIELD_COST']='count'
            elif phase=='time': os.environ['TSR_MEMBER_FIELD_COST']='time'
            else: os.environ.pop('TSR_MEMBER_FIELD_COST',None)
            command=[binary['path'],'--project',str(project),'--pretty','false','--noEmit','--incremental','false','--composite','false','--listFiles','--extendedDiagnostics']
            if mode=='single': command+=['--singleThreaded','true']
            row=perf.process(command,project.parent,180)
            row.update(mode=mode,role=role,phase=phase,binary_sha256=binary['sha256'],observed_inputs_stable=before==perf.inputs.snapshot(paths)==reference,diagnostics=perf.diagnostics(row['stdout'],project.parent),events=counts(row['stderr']))
            rows.append(row)
            (r/'public-progress.json').write_text(json.dumps({'rows':rows,'complete':False},indent=2)+'\n')
            assert not row['timed_out'] and row['observed_inputs_stable'] and row['exit_code']==1
            own=next(v for v in rows if v['mode']==mode and v['role']==role and v['phase']=='ordinary')
            assert own['diagnostics']==row['diagnostics'] and listed(own['stdout'])==listed(row['stdout'])
            if phase in ['ordinary','off']: assert row['events']==[]
            else: assert row['events']
            print(json.dumps({'role':role,'mode':mode,'phase':phase,'wall_seconds':row['wall_seconds'],'events':len(row['events'])}),flush=True)
os.environ.pop('TSR_MEMBER_FIELD_COST',None)
record={'source_revision':setup['source_revision'],'rows':rows,'complete':True,'ordinary_binaries':ordinary,'observer_binaries':observer,'observed_inputs_fingerprint':perf.fingerprint(reference),'driver_sha256':hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'actual_checked_identities_verified':False,'full_filesystem_query_inputs_verified':False}
(r/'public.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n'); assert json.loads((r/'public.json').read_text())==record

        assert prefix in ['MEMBER_LEGACY','MEMBER_PUBLICATION','MEMBER_SYMBOL_STORAGE']
        events.append({'kind':prefix,'counts':json.loads(payload)})
    return events
def listed(stdout):
    return [line for line in stdout.splitlines() if line.startswith(('/', 'bundled:///')) and line.endswith(('.ts','.tsx','.mts','.cts'))]
for mode in ['single','default']:
    for role in ['main','publication']:
        for phase in ['ordinary','off','count','time','count-repeat']:
            binary=ordinary[role] if phase=='ordinary' else observer[role]
            assert hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(binary['path']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==binary['sha256']
            before=perf.inputs.snapshot(paths); assert before==reference
            if phase in ['count','count-repeat']: os.environ['TSR_MEMBER_FIELD_COST']='count'
            elif phase=='time': os.environ['TSR_MEMBER_FIELD_COST']='time'
            else: os.environ.pop('TSR_MEMBER_FIELD_COST',None)
            command=[binary['path'],'--project',str(project),'--pretty','false','--noEmit','--incremental','false','--composite','false','--listFiles','--extendedDiagnostics']
            if mode=='single': command+=['--singleThreaded','true']
            row=perf.process(command,project.parent,180)
            row.update(mode=mode,role=role,phase=phase,binary_sha256=binary['sha256'],observed_inputs_stable=before==perf.inputs.snapshot(paths)==reference,diagnostics=perf.diagnostics(row['stdout'],project.parent),events=counts(row['stderr']))
            rows.append(row)
            (r/'storage-progress.json').write_text(json.dumps({'rows':rows,'complete':False},indent=2)+'\n')
            assert not row['timed_out'] and row['observed_inputs_stable'] and row['exit_code']==1
            own=next(v for v in rows if v['mode']==mode and v['role']==role and v['phase']=='ordinary')
            assert own['diagnostics']==row['diagnostics'] and listed(own['stdout'])==listed(row['stdout'])
            if phase in ['ordinary','off']: assert row['events']==[]
            else: assert row['events']
            print(json.dumps({'role':role,'mode':mode,'phase':phase,'wall_seconds':row['wall_seconds'],'events':len(row['events'])}),flush=True)
os.environ.pop('TSR_MEMBER_FIELD_COST',None)
record={'source_revision':setup['source_revision'],'rows':rows,'complete':True,'ordinary_binaries':ordinary,'observer_binaries':observer,'observed_inputs_fingerprint':perf.fingerprint(reference),'driver_sha256':hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'actual_checked_identities_verified':False,'full_filesystem_query_inputs_verified':False}
(r/'storage.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n'); assert json.loads((r/'storage.json').read_text())==record

import difflib
import hashlib
import json
import pathlib
import shutil
import subprocess

repo = pathlib.Path('<repo>')
r = pathlib.Path(pathlib.Path('/tmp/tsr-member-fields-path').read_text().strip())
setup = json.loads((r / 'setup.json').read_text())
revision = setup['source_revision']
scratch = repo / (r / 'spec-path').read_text().strip()

def save(path, value):
    path.write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2) + '\n')
    assert json.loads(path.read_text()) == value

reader = json.loads((r / 'count-reader.json').read_text())
log = json.loads((scratch / 'experiment-log.yaml').read_text())
entry = log['experiments'][0]
entry.update(records=['public.json', 'storage.json', 'controls.json', 'count-reader.json'],
             qualification='106 terminal CLI children; all observer modes preserve each ordinary role output. Counter partitions and repeated per-owner non-time counts pass. Native TS2310 differs from ordinary main on reset control and agrees with publication. No full corpus or complete checked/query-input proof.',
             actual_worker_cost_selected=False,
             metrics=reader['aggregate_timed_rows'],
             outcome='measured_locating_no_runtime_retention')
log['baseline'] = {'source_revision': revision, 'records': 'storage.json',
                   'ordinary_rows_only': True, 'paired_median_or_native_ratio': False}
log['best'] = {'runtime_change': None, 'target_met': False}
log['hypothesis_backlog'][0]['outcome'] = 'measured; further member memo not selected'
log['next'] = 'Existing tsr-1yb.7.7.1.2 owns private symbol capacity/access costs; coordinate a separate private-layout design there. tsr-1yb.4.2.1 still needs eligible expensive worker attribution, not another declaration memo.'
save(scratch / 'experiment-log.yaml', log)
save(r / 'result.yaml', entry)
digest = '''# Member cost selection at 53896fa4

This is a locating measurement, not a retained runtime optimization.
The private publication prototype removes 593159 declared lookups in default
mode, but the ordinary root interval is only 36.831ms including observer clocks
and nested work. Typed forcing remains similar. These overlapping intervals
cannot be added or treated as saved CPU/wall time. Publication hits are 99.06%.
Another member/declaration memo is not selected from this evidence.

The prototype creates 56360 members (42097 single), and the real private store
reserves 65536 slots at 184 bytes: 12058624 inline bytes. Five table-clone sites
copy 963043 bytes of string payload in default mode; this excludes allocator,
signature vector payload and individual-entry copies. No allocation count or
RSS attribution is inferred. Ordinary main has only checker sentinel records.

Existing tsr-1yb.7.7.1.2 owns symbol_access.rs storage/access costs. A private
layout proposal must preserve absent/empty/populated field semantics and native
ownership identities, and remains distinct from the rejected bound-table
compact-layout experiment. Coordinate with tsr-1yb.33.1 before implementation.
Do not close tsr-1yb.4.2.1 from one public project's small declared intervals.
Host activity, active-frame and composite scope, full corpus and actual checked
identities remain unqualified. The complete-work native <=0.50 target is unmet.
'''
(scratch / 'strategy-digest.md').write_text(digest)
assert (scratch / 'strategy-digest.md').read_text() == digest

def patch_for(source, hashes):
    changes = []
    final_hashes = {}
    paths = sorted(set(hashes) | set(setup['baseline_rust_hashes']))
    for path in paths:
        baseline = subprocess.run(['git', 'show', revision + ':' + path], cwd=repo,
                                  capture_output=True)
        before = baseline.stdout if baseline.returncode == 0 else b''
        after = (source / path).read_bytes() if (source / path).exists() else b''
        if before == after:
            continue
        final_hashes[path] = hashlib.sha256(after).hexdigest()
        changes.append('diff --git a/' + path + ' b/' + path + '\n')
        if not before:
            changes.append('new file mode 100644\n')
        changes.extend(line if line != ' \n' else '\n' for line in difflib.unified_diff(before.decode().splitlines(True),
                       after.decode().splitlines(True),
                       fromfile='a/' + path if before else '/dev/null',
                       tofile='b/' + path if after else '/dev/null'))
    return ''.join(changes), final_hashes

main_build = json.loads((r / 'legacy-storage.json').read_text())
candidate_build = json.loads((r / 'publication-storage.json').read_text())
main_patch, main_hashes = patch_for(r / 'source', main_build['source_hashes_after'])
candidate_patch, candidate_hashes = patch_for(r / 'candidate', candidate_build['source_hashes_after'])
(r / 'main-observer.patch').write_text(main_patch)
(r / 'publication-combined.patch').write_text(candidate_patch)

replays = {}
for role, patch, expected in [('main', main_patch, main_hashes),
                              ('publication', candidate_patch, candidate_hashes)]:
    target = r / ('replay-' + role)
    if target.exists():
        shutil.rmtree(target)
    target.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    for path in expected:
        old = subprocess.run(['git', 'show', revision + ':' + path], cwd=repo,
                             capture_output=True)
        if old.returncode == 0:
            (target / path).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            (target / path).write_bytes(old.stdout)
    patchpath = r / (role + '-replay-input.patch')
    patchpath.write_text(patch)
    calls = []
    for arguments in [['git', 'apply', '--check', str(patchpath)],
                      ['git', 'apply', str(patchpath)]]:
        result = subprocess.run(arguments, cwd=target, capture_output=True, text=True)
        calls.append({'command': arguments, 'returncode': result.returncode,
                      'stdout': result.stdout, 'stderr': result.stderr})
        if result.returncode != 0:
            save(r / 'patch-replay-failure.json', {'role': role, 'commands': calls})
        assert result.returncode == 0, calls
    actual = {p: hashlib.sha256((target / p).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in expected}
    assert actual == expected
    replays[role] = {'commands': calls, 'paths': len(expected), 'hashes': actual,
                     'matches_final_build_sources': True}
save(r / 'patch-replay.json', replays)

prior = pathlib.Path(setup['prior_archive'])
records = {p.name: json.loads(p.read_text()) for p in r.glob('*.json')
           if p.name not in ['controls-progress.json', 'public-progress.json', 'storage-progress.json']}
drivers = {p.name: {'source': p.read_text(), 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
           for p in sorted(r.glob('*.py'))}
drivers['observer-module.rs'] = {'source': (r / 'observer-module.rs').read_text(),
                                'sha256': hashlib.sha256((r / 'observer-module.rs').read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
for driver in ['tsr-publish-member-fields.py', 'tsr-member-field-checks.py', 'tsr-member-field-reader.py', 'tsr-member-field-reuse.py']:
    path = pathlib.Path('/tmp') / driver
    drivers[driver] = {'source': path.read_text(), 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
receipt = {'purpose': 'Passive source-bound member query/copy/storage attribution; no runtime retention',
           'source_revision': revision, 'native_revision': setup['native_revision'],
           'fixture_revision': setup['fixture_revision'], 'records': records,
           'ordinary_build_records': {name: json.loads((prior / name).read_text())
                                     for name in ['baseline-pinned-build.json', 'member-alias-build.json']},
           'drivers': drivers, 'main_observer_patch': main_patch,
           'publication_combined_patch': candidate_patch,
           'experiment_log': log, 'strategy_digest': digest,
           'spec': (scratch / 'spec.yaml').read_text(), 'runtime_optimization': False,
           'qualification': {'full_package_or_corpora_claimed': False,
                             'actual_checked_identities_verified': False,
                             'full_filesystem_query_inputs_verified': False,
                             'host_activity_controlled': False,
                             'driver_sha256_is_before_path_redaction': True,
                             'repeated_counts_match_unordered_owner_records': True,
                             'stable_owner_identity_matching_verified': False,
                             'intervals_additive': False, 'allocation_events_measured': False}}

def sanitize(value):
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        return {sanitize(k): sanitize(v) for k, v in value.items()}
    if isinstance(value, list):
        return [sanitize(v) for v in value]
    if not isinstance(value, str):
        return value
    replacements = [(str(r.resolve()), '<archive>'), (str(r), '<archive>'),
                    (str(prior.resolve()), '<prior-archive>'),
                    (str(prior).removeprefix('/private'), '<prior-archive>'),
                    (str(repo), '<repo>')]
    for old, new in replacements:
        value = value.replace(old, new)
    return value

out = repo / 'docs/architecture/checker-member-field-cost'
save(out.with_suffix('.json'), sanitize(receipt))
out.with_suffix('.patch').write_text(main_patch)
assert out.with_suffix('.patch').read_text() == main_patch
print(json.dumps({'main_patch_paths': len(main_hashes),
                  'publication_combined_paths': len(candidate_hashes),
                  'receipt_bytes': out.with_suffix('.json').stat().st_size,
                  'replayed': True, 'checkpoint_verified': True}))

import hashlib
import json
import os
import pathlib
import re
import subprocess
import time

repo = pathlib.Path('<repo>')
r = pathlib.Path(pathlib.Path('/tmp/tsr-member-fields-path').read_text().strip())
env = dict(os.environ, CARGO_TARGET_DIR=str(r / 'source/target'),
           CARGO_BUILD_JOBS='2', PATH='/tmp/tsr-beads-1.3.1:' + os.environ['PATH'])
before = {str(p.relative_to(repo)): hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
          for p in (repo / 'xtask').rglob('*.rs')}
rows = []
for name, cmd in [('build', ['rtk', 'proxy', 'cargo', 'build', '--offline', '--release', '-p', 'xtask']),
                  ('anchors', [str(r / 'source/target/release/xtask'), 'anchors']),
                  ('sections', [str(r / 'source/target/release/xtask'), 'sections']),
                  ('issue-ids', [str(r / 'source/target/release/xtask'), 'issue-ids'])]:
    start = time.monotonic()
    child = subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=repo, env=env, capture_output=True, text=True)
    row = {'check': name, 'command': cmd, 'returncode': child.returncode,
           'seconds': time.monotonic() - start, 'stdout': child.stdout, 'stderr': child.stderr}
    rows.append(row)
    print(json.dumps({'check': name, 'returncode': child.returncode,
                      'tail': (child.stdout + child.stderr)[-600:]}), flush=True)
    assert child.returncode == (1 if name == 'issue-ids' else 0), row
after = {str(p.relative_to(repo)): hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
         for p in (repo / 'xtask').rglob('*.rs')}
assert before == after
errors = rows[-1]['stdout'] + rows[-1]['stderr']
assert '191 issue id(s)' in errors
paths = sorted(set(re.findall(r'^\s+((?:crates|docs)/.+?):\d+', errors, re.M)))
historical = {}
revision = json.loads((r / 'setup.json').read_text())['source_revision']
for path in paths:
    old = subprocess.run(['git', 'show', revision + ':' + path], cwd=repo, capture_output=True)
    assert old.returncode == 0 and old.stdout == (repo / path).read_bytes()
    historical[path] = hashlib.sha256(old.stdout).hexdigest()
assert historical
for issue in ['tsr-1yb.7.7.1.2', 'tsr-1yb.4.2.1', 'tsr-1yb.33.1', 'tsr-1yb.34']:
    child = subprocess.run(['/tmp/tsr-beads-1.3.1/bd', 'show', issue, '--json'],
                           cwd=repo, capture_output=True, text=True)
    assert child.returncode == 0 and json.loads(child.stdout)[0]['id'] == issue
record = {'rows': rows, 'source_stable': True, 'source_hashes': before,
          'issue_gate': '191 historical unresolved IDs; containing files byte-identical',
          'historical_paths': historical, 'new_issue_ids_resolve': True}
(r / 'documentation-checks.json').write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + '\n')
assert json.loads((r / 'documentation-checks.json').read_text()) == record
